activities_owner_source_idx.name: activities_owner_source_idx
activities_owner_source_idx.where: "activities"."source_system" IS NOT NULL AND "activities"."source_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activities"."deleted_at" IS NULL

activities_values_valid.name: activities_values_valid
activities_values_valid.value: length(trim("activities"."name"))>0 AND ("activities"."duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "activities"."duration_minutes">=0) AND ("activities"."calories_kcal" IS NULL OR "activities"."calories_kcal">=0) AND "activities"."version">0 AND "activities"."source_unit"='kcal' AND "activities"."sync_status"='confirmed'

energy_days_values_valid.name: energy_days_values_valid
energy_days_values_valid.value: ("energy_days"."resting_kcal" IS NULL OR "energy_days"."resting_kcal">=0) AND ("energy_days"."active_kcal" IS NULL OR "energy_days"."active_kcal">=0) AND ("energy_days"."total_kcal" IS NULL OR "energy_days"."total_kcal">=0) AND "energy_days"."version">0 AND "energy_days"."source_unit"='kcal' AND "energy_days"."sync_status"='confirmed'

energy_operations_valid.name: energy_operations_valid
energy_operations_valid.value: "energy_operations"."origin" IN ('manual','ai') AND "energy_operations"."status" IN ('pending','confirmed','cancelled') AND "energy_operations"."revision">0 AND (("energy_operations"."origin"='manual' AND "energy_operations"."token_id" IS NULL AND "energy_operations"."oauth_connection_id" IS NULL) OR ("energy_operations"."origin"='ai' AND num_nonnulls("energy_operations"."token_id","energy_operations"."oauth_connection_id")=1))

foods_nutrition_valid.name: foods_nutrition_valid
foods_nutrition_valid.value: ("foods"."calories_kcal" IS NULL OR "foods"."calories_kcal">=0) AND ("foods"."protein_g" IS NULL OR "foods"."protein_g">=0) AND ("foods"."carbs_g" IS NULL OR "foods"."carbs_g">=0) AND ("foods"."fat_g" IS NULL OR "foods"."fat_g">=0)

meals_time_valid.name: meals_time_valid
meals_time_valid.value: "meals"."occurred_at" IS NULL OR "meals"."timezone" IS NOT NULL

meal_items_nutrition_valid.name: meal_items_nutrition_valid
meal_items_nutrition_valid.value: ("meal_items"."calories_kcal" IS NULL OR "meal_items"."calories_kcal">=0) AND ("meal_items"."protein_g" IS NULL OR "meal_items"."protein_g">=0) AND ("meal_items"."carbs_g" IS NULL OR "meal_items"."carbs_g">=0) AND ("meal_items"."fat_g" IS NULL OR "meal_items"."fat_g">=0)

meal_operations_credential_valid.name: meal_operations_credential_valid
meal_operations_credential_valid.value: ("meal_operations"."origin"='ai' AND num_nonnulls("meal_operations"."token_id","meal_operations"."oauth_connection_id")=1 AND "meal_operations"."import_id" IS NULL) OR ("meal_operations"."origin"='manual' AND num_nonnulls("meal_operations"."token_id","meal_operations"."oauth_connection_id","meal_operations"."import_id")=0) OR ("meal_operations"."origin"='initialization' AND num_nonnulls("meal_operations"."token_id","meal_operations"."oauth_connection_id")=0 AND "meal_operations"."import_id" IS NOT NULL)

measurements_metric_presence.name: measurements_metric_presence
measurements_metric_presence.value: "measurements"."weight_kg" IS NOT NULL OR "measurements"."body_fat_percent" IS NOT NULL

measurements_instant_has_timezone.name: measurements_instant_has_timezone
measurements_instant_has_timezone.value: "measurements"."occurred_at" IS NULL OR "measurements"."timezone" IS NOT NULL

measurements_estimation_valid.name: measurements_estimation_valid
measurements_estimation_valid.value: ("measurements"."record_kind" = 'estimated' AND "measurements"."estimation" IS NOT NULL AND "measurements"."occurred_at" IS NULL) OR ("measurements"."record_kind" = 'observed' AND "measurements"."estimation" IS NULL)
